blocks.text: With the office closed tomorrow for the holiday, I would like next week settled before either of us leaves today. I will be out on Monday morning, so please move our weekly docket review to Tuesday afternoon, which also gives you Monday to log the mail that came in over the break and to check the reminders against it.

Please also hold the conference room for Wednesday morning, when the attorneys meet to go over the January calendar, and make sure the speakerphone is working, since several people will be dialing in. If Tuesday afternoon does not suit you, send me another time today and I will move my own calendar around it.
